build_information_content_sum: build a python module that estimates total information content in bits from a tensor of probabilities using sum reduction
build_information_content_batch: build a python module that estimates per-batch-element information content from probabilities using batch_el reduction
build_information_content_natural: build a python module that computes per-element information content with no reduction using a natural log base
test_information_content_reduction: test the information_content function with all three reduction modes sum batch_el and none
review_information_content: review the information_content function and its Shannon entropy estimation using logarithm base conversion
